cab6cd4d8b0e75b6.description: Business Development & Project Acquisition Engineer Overview We are looking for an outstanding expert in business development and project acquisition to join our team as a strategic partner on a project-based system. This opportunity aims to strengthen our presence in the Saudi market and contribute to building long-term strategic partnerships that contribute to the company's growth and expansion of its business scope in the city of Riyadh. Responsibilities and Duties Develop and implement effective strategic plans to bring in new projects and expand the client base. Conduct regular market research to identify available opportunities and follow industry trends. Build and maintain strong relationships with potential clients and decision-makers in major companies. Prepare and submit presentations, as well as technical and financial proposals for tenders and projects. Negotiate contracts and agreements to ensure the best returns for the company. Work on closing deals and achieving the agreed-upon sales targets. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or any related field. At least 5 years of practical experience in business development or technical sales within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. A proven track record in project management and dealing with government entities and the private sector. Deep understanding of the local market dynamics in Riyadh. High professionalism in building a wide professional network. The ability to work independently and manage time with high efficiency. An opportunity to work within a professional environment that supports innovation and professional growth.

ca4d2634c691c140.job_title: Tamayyaz Guest Service Agent Saudis Only
ca4d2634c691c140.description: About IBIS and the Tamayyaz Program IBIS is offering a full-time opportunity in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia, through its Tamayyaz Nationalization Development Program. The Tamayyaz program is designed to equip Saudi talents with essential skills and knowledge for various hospitality professions through a combination of classroom instruction and on-the-job training within a structured timeframe. Role Overview: Guest Service Agent The Tamayyaz Guest Service Agent is responsible for ensuring a smooth and courteous experience for guests from arrival to departure. This role involves managing daily front office operations, handling guest inquiries and requests, and maintaining efficient communication across departments to support overall hotel operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare for daily arrivals, including room allocation and checking for special guest requests. Register and process guest check-ins, updating information in the system. Perform cashiering duties, foreign exchange transactions, night audit tasks, and settlement upon guest departure. Handle walk-in counter reservations and process call-in reservations when the room reservations section is closed. Provide courteous service, responding promptly to all guest requests and inquiries. Resolve guest complaints and requests, liaising with relevant departments for immediate follow-up and reporting issues to supervisors. Manage the issuance of guest room key cards and ensure effective control for guest security. Check and convey messages to guests. Assist at the Information counter, Foreign Exchange, Night Audit, and Business Centre as assigned. Review the log book, verify outstanding items, and follow up on pending tasks, identifying any special assignments for the day. Monitor hotel situation, occupancy, functions, groups, and VIPs. File daily reception reports and documents systematically. Print panic reports at least twice per shift. Attend briefings, take notes, and ensure appropriate follow-up actions. Maintain focus on guests, eye contact, and acknowledge all guests at the desk. Communicate all necessary information to the next shift for continuous operational efficiency. Coordinate and share information with Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B, and the General Manager, particularly regarding VIPs. Maintain familiarity with company documentation and operational standards relevant to the role. Ensure perfect grooming at all times. Drive upselling initiatives. Carry out any other reasonable tasks as requested. Qualifications and Requirements This program is exclusively for Saudi Nationals. Open to candidates with 0-1 year of work experience, including fresh graduates and those with up to 6 months of relevant experience. Basic English language skills are required. Demonstrated strong passion for the hospitality field. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work effectively as a team player and proactively assist co-workers. Flexibility to work a roster that adapts to departmental needs. Ability to focus on guest needs, maintaining a calm and courteous demeanor at all times. Diversity and Inclusion IBIS is committed to diversity and inclusion, aiming to attract, recruit, and promote diverse talent within its workforce.

ca64259af38e9775.description: About Magrabi Health Magrabi Health is seeking a Medical Coordinator to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for supporting the daily functions of our outpatient medical units and ensuring a seamless, patient-focused experience. Role Overview The Medical Coordinator will play a crucial role in managing patient interactions and administrative tasks within our healthcare environment. This position requires a professional who can effectively coordinate various aspects of patient care, from scheduling to record keeping, while maintaining high standards of service and compliance. Key Responsibilities Coordinate patient appointments, schedules, and medical records. Welcome patients, respond to inquiries, and provide guidance throughout their visit. Liaise with physicians, clinical teams, reception, call center, and admission staff. Verify insurance information and support billing documentation. Address patient concerns and follow up with the relevant care teams. Maintain accurate records, confidentiality, and compliance with hospital policies. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a similar role within a hospital or healthcare environment. Required Skills Good knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare procedures. Strong communication, organization, multitasking, and interpersonal skills. Patient-focused, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Ensuring data security and implementing security measures to protect the organization's information. Providing technical support to users and training them on new technologies. caddd334b238f8ab.description: About Dar As Sihha Medical Center Dar As Sihha Medical Center is a well-established healthcare provider in Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, serving the community since 1996. The center is registered with the Saudi Ministry of Health and is known for its patient-centric approach and high-quality medical care. It operates 24/7 with a fully equipped emergency department and a multidisciplinary team of specialist physicians and technicians. The Role of ENT Specialist Dar As Sihha Medical Center is seeking a Full-time ENT Specialist to provide comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for patients. This role involves managing a wide range of ear, nose, and throat conditions, ensuring integrated patient management through collaboration with other medical specialists. Key Responsibilities Provide comprehensive ENT consultations, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care. Assess and manage patients with ear, nose, throat, and related conditions. Perform clinical examinations and interpret diagnostic tests. Develop individualized treatment plans and perform relevant ENT procedures within professional qualifications. Coordinate pre- and post-operative care. Collaborate effectively with other physicians and healthcare professionals to ensure integrated patient management. Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records. Adhere to clinical protocols and Ministry of Health regulations. Participate in quality improvement and infection control initiatives. Educate patients regarding diagnosis, treatment, and preventive care. Contribute to emergency coverage as needed. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience as an ENT Specialist. Relevant medical qualifications and licensure. Demonstrated expertise in diagnostic and therapeutic care for ENT conditions. Professional Standards The successful candidate will be expected to maintain high standards of patient safety, quality of care, and professional ethics, aligning with the center's commitment to compassion, respect, and dignity. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

ca1a8d271025912e.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role focuses on ensuring excellent customer reception within showrooms, maintaining high service standards, and meeting customer needs both before and after sales. The representative will manage the customer journey from entry to order fulfillment, including product coordination, invoicing, and proper goods delivery. Key Responsibilities Ensure the showroom remains organized and clean at all times. Confirm the availability of all marketing tools, such as brochures and catalogues. Achieve sales targets as outlined in the sales plan. Meet management goals and implement required Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Process online customer requests and update the E-commerce platform, considering item requirements and stock levels. Maintain adequate stock of all items, particularly fast-moving ones, by adhering to ordering policies from warehouses based on minimum and maximum levels, and applying the first-in, first-out (FIFO) policy to prevent dead stock. Report any missing products in the main store to the direct manager. Ensure goods are arranged in warehouses according to policy and procedure guidelines to maintain accurate stock and prevent discrepancies during periodic inventory checks. Submit financial reports to the regional accountant as required and deposit all daily cash sales into the company’s account. Provide regular reports to the direct manager regarding competitors' activities and promotions. Handle customer complaints professionally and report them to the direct manager. Maintain order within the showroom environment. Collaborate with other branches to facilitate the resale of slow-moving items. Implement company policies and instructions. Submit periodic reports detailing achievements, problems, and failures to the direct manager. Offer constructive ideas and suggestions to enhance the sales process and value. Execute all assigned activities using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any additional duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Customer Interaction and Coordination The Showroom Sales Representative is responsible for guiding customers from their initial entry into the showroom through to securing their orders. This includes assisting with color and product coordination, issuing invoices, and ensuring proper delivery of goods. The role also involves coordinating effectively with all showroom staff, including assistants, workers, and drivers, to ensure smooth operations and a cohesive customer experience. Operational Compliance This position requires strict adherence to company policies and procedures, particularly concerning inventory management and financial reporting. The representative will play a crucial role in maintaining accurate stock levels, preventing dead stock through the FIFO policy, and ensuring all sales transactions are properly documented and reported. Regular communication with the direct manager on operational matters and market intelligence is also essential. Reporting and Improvement The representative will be responsible for providing regular reports on sales performance, competitor activities, and any operational challenges. A proactive approach to identifying areas for improvement in the sales process and offering valuable suggestions is expected. This includes reporting on achievements, problems, and failures to the direct manager to support continuous improvement initiatives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring active engagement within the showroom environment and coordination with various internal teams to ensure efficient customer service and operational excellence.

ca6d8498b5e0eb8c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اعمال طروق للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في قطاع المقاولات. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة اعمال طروق للمقاولات.

ca79631fb35c63e8.description: About the Strategic Partner Program Innovation Consulting Group (ICG) is expanding its Strategic Partner ecosystem and invites business leaders, consulting firms, industry experts, executive advisors, and entrepreneurial professionals to collaborate on strategic transformation opportunities across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. These solutions assist organizations in designing, building, operating, optimizing, and continuously transforming their business operations and digital ecosystems. Through its integrated delivery model, partners gain access to experienced consultants, solution architects, enterprise architects, engineers, technology specialists, project managers, researchers, trainers, delivery teams, and managed services capabilities. Collaborate across one or multiple ICG service lines. Participate in executive engagements, opportunity development, and deal progression activities. ca7df8eb3b2b6ed7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ظافر مشبب الجابري للخدمات اللوجستية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات وتقييم أدائها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية عند الضرورة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مكرس لتحقيق أهداف الشركة في مجال الخدمات اللوجستية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

ca9c83b8e05da4aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سيف الطبية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وترويج المنتجات الطبية، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. المهام الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات. إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين. التواصل مع العملاء لتقديم عروض البيع واستعراض مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع، تحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. إدارة علاقات العملاء متابعة العملاء بعد إتمام عملية البيع لضمان رضاهم. إدارة ملفات العملاء والشركات وتحديث البيانات بشكل مستمر ودوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء وإدارة قواعد بيانات العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض قوية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة سيف الطبية، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

caa6f5582df27799.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Guest Experience Expert to join the team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on creating a unique and memorable experience for guests, extending beyond standard check-in and check-out processes. The Guest Experience Expert takes initiative to provide a wide range of services and guidance throughout the guest's stay. Key Responsibilities Perform operational tasks to ensure smooth hotel function. Attend to guest requests promptly and efficiently. Complete necessary reports and documentation. Provide information and commentary on local area events and highlights. Ensure all interactions contribute positively to the overall guest experience. Workplace Standards and Physical Demands Success in this role requires adherence to fundamental standards, including maintaining a safe workspace, following company guidelines and procedures, respecting confidentiality, protecting company assets, and upholding quality standards. Professional appearance, uniform, and communication are essential. Guest Experience Experts are expected to be active, involving standing, sitting, and walking for extended periods. The role also involves tasks such as moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, and placing objects weighing less than 10 pounds without assistance. Consistent performance of these tasks is crucial for guest satisfaction and hotel operations. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent General Educational Development (GED) certificate. Related Work Experience: No related work experience required (0-1 years). Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience required. License or Certification: None required. Company Culture and Values Sheraton Hotels & Resorts, part of Marriott International, is committed to equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive environment where diversity is valued. caacbef72f43d23e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة درع اسوار للحراسات الأمنية عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في البكيرية، القصيم. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل لمراقبة الممتلكات ضد السرقة والتخريب. مراقبة منافذ الدخول والخروج إلى المنشأة، والتحقق من هويات الزوار والموردين وتسجيلها، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول اللازمة. تفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها وإغلاقها بشكل صحيح. التجول بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، والتأكد من تطبيق اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والحوادث، والتحقيق فيها، والتواصل مع الجهات المختصة مثل إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالنتائج. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المنشأة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الحراسات الأمنية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على المراقبة الفعالة واتخاذ القرارات السريعة في المواقف الطارئة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على التعامل مع مختلف الأفراد. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالتعليمات والسياسات الأمنية. اللياقة البدنية للقيام بالدوريات والمراقبة. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في شركة درع اسوار للحراسات الأمنية، حيث يساهم في توفير بيئة آمنة ومستقرة للموظفين والزوار والممتلكات في البكيرية، القصيم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

ca5c10d920deac6c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسكو عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتضمن هذا الدور مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سلامة وكفاءة التمديدات الكهربائية، وتشمل ما يلي: دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بأنواعها المختلفة (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة مع مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يُطلب من المرشحين امتلاك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية لتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التمديدات الكهربائية ضمن فريق شركة اسكو في مدينة عنيزة بمنطقة القصيم. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة.

ca728dc3dbbb10c9.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Project Control Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on a major infrastructure program for a mixed-use development. The project aims to establish a global landmark in Riyadh, recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination, creating a distinct, self-sustaining hub with iconic assets. Role Overview Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Project Control Manager is responsible for maintaining, governing, implementing, and providing pre- and post-contract implementation governance for Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes. This role supports reporting requirements and systems such as Aconex, Unifier, and P6. Regular review and updates of existing governance documents on a quarterly or annual basis are required. Key Responsibilities Onboard and train PMCs to facilitate understanding of the program, policies, processes, and associated project management information systems and applications. Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents, continuously updating the PMC onboarding tracker. Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all downstream levels. Review the existing structure, propose improvements, and align with required updates/changes. Maintain, review, and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans, manuals, guidelines, and templates. Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive program meeting and reporting calendar for assigned Districts/Master Plans. Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparing and creating new BI dashboards and data entry registers through approved systems (*, SharePoint, Unifier). Compile data from PMCs for standardized weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards. Perform project-level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, and change management. Ensure consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports. Assist with the preparation of training material for PMCs on the use of implemented systems and data population. Provide support to the client's Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements. Maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring PMC performance against agreed KPIs, producing a monthly report highlighting performance and required corrective actions. Update the status of corrective actions during subsequent reporting cycles. Assess existing monitoring systems and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process. Ensure PMC reporting schedules are consistent with PMO executive report preparation. Review and collate District/Master Plan programs to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies. Produce a "Key Actions Required" report and escalation process for executive management. Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report, highlighting overall program, district, and individual project status and progress, including status against approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues. Manage and update the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded in the WBS change register. Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects. Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Reports. Prepare required inputs for Executive Reports, including program and commercial updates and "asks" requirements from client information. Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates with communication and training for PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost). Develop and maintain a standardized Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programs and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting, aligning CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements. Develop and maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure all project scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project controls or a related field. Demonstrated experience with project management information systems (PMIS) such as Aconex, Unifier, and P6. Proven ability to develop, implement, and govern project controls policies and procedures. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Company Overview KBR, Inc. provides PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight across various projects and programs within this major infrastructure initiative.

ca791aff2c4fe007.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخفجي. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء لضمان كفاءة الأداء وسلامة التشغيل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم لضمان استمرارية عملها بكفاءة. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع المهام والعمليات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). معرفة قوية بتركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وتطبيقها في العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ca54029d8678869e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف المشاريع (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدوائر الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. فهم شامل لمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية. القدرة على تقدير المواد وتأمين التجهيزات ومطابقة المواصفات. مهارة في تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل سيعمل الفني الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة في منطقة الباحة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة حسب طبيعة المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

caa11aaa9c815392.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث المحافظة للتعليم عن أخصائي اضطرابات تخاطب للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مشكلات النطق لدى الأطفال، وتصميم برامج تدريبية متخصصة، ومتابعة تجهيز وتشغيل المختبرات التعليمية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي اضطرابات التخاطب مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان تقديم رعاية متكاملة للأطفال الذين يعانون من صعوبات في النطق، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تحديد المستوى النطقي للطفل وتحديد الحروف التي يصعب لفظها. تحديد الأهداف التعليمية طويلة وقصيرة الأمد، وإعداد وتنفيذ محتوى البرامج التعليمية والتدريبية المختلفة. اختيار واستخدام طرق التعليم الفعالة لتدريس النطق، وإعداد خطط الدروس التطبيقية وتنفيذها. تصميم أدوات تقييم لتقدم الأطفال واتخاذ الإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة. إعداد بنود مستلزمات المختبرات التدريسية الخاصة بالنطق، مثل الحاسوب والوسائل البصرية والمرايا، وتحديد كمياتها ومواصفاتها وتركيبها وتشغيلها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال النطق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالنطق وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال النطق. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخلفية التعليمية والخبرة العملية المناسبة للتعامل مع اضطرابات التخاطب: خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال اضطرابات التخاطب. القدرة على دراسة مشكلات النطق وتحديد الصعوبات اللفظية لدى الأطفال. مهارات في تصميم وتنفيذ البرامج التدريبية المتخصصة في مجال النطق. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي اضطرابات التخاطب ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية، حيث يساهم في تطوير قدرات الأطفال اللغوية والنطقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

caff68c4a14b7902.description: KSA National – National Talent & Compliance Lead At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone. We use these values to fuel superior results: Lock arms We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good. Show hustle We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional. Embrace change From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next. Elevate empathy We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability. Never settle We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas. But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. We are seeking an experienced KSA national professional to join us as our new National Talent & Compliance Lead. This is a senior role with two parts. The larger part is compliance & visas: you will become our primary in-house point of contact for Saudization, government relations and the full visa and immigration lifecycle for our people and their families, taking on responsibilities we have historically relied on an external PRO company to manage. The second part is Saudi national hiring: leading our efforts to attract, source and recruit outstanding Saudi national talent, and helping us stay ahead of our Nitaqat obligations rather than reacting to them. What you’ll do: Compliance & Visas Manage the end-to-end visa and immigration process for expatriate employees and their eligible family members — work visas, iqama issuance and renewal, dependent/family visas, and exit/re-entry and cancellation processes. Apply for and manage the different types of visas needed for Horizontal Digital employees travelling to Saudi Arabia for work (e.g., business/visit visas). Work with our insurance broker to add new employees and eligible family members to our health insurance plan, and manage related updates, amendments and removals. Own our Nitaqat/Saudization position — track our Saudi/non-Saudi headcount ratio and quota band on an ongoing basis, and proactively flag to leadership when we are approaching or sitting in the or red zone, together with recommended corrective action. Act as Horizontal Digital’s primary point of contact for Saudization, visas and government relations matters Monitor and interpret changes to KSA labour law, MHRSD regulations, and Qiwa/Muqeem/GOSI/visa platform requirements, and translate these into clear, practical guidance for leadership and HR. Own the government-related and administrative side of onboarding and offboarding for employees, contractors and their families — visas, iqama, labour contracts, GOSI registration, health insurance enrolment/removal and similar — coordinating closely with HR, IT and hiring managers. Keep leadership and the HR team up to date on Saudization-, visa- and labour law-related rules, deadlines and obligations that affect the business. Maintain accurate compliance, visa and insurance tracking and reporting, and prepare regular updates for leadership. Saudi National Hiring Lead sourcing, screening and recruitment for Saudi national hires, building and maintaining a strong, ongoing pipeline of Saudi talent across our open roles. Identify, propose and help build programs and initiatives to attract, develop and retain Saudi national employees (for example, university and graduate partnerships, or engagement with relevant government talent initiatives). Partner with hiring managers and leadership on workforce planning that factors in Saudization targets and quota requirements from the outset. Maintain accurate candidate tracking and reporting in our Applicant Tracking System. Support wider Talent Acquisition and HR projects and administrative tasks as needed. Act as culture ambassador for the Saudi team which consists of Saudi nationals and expats, supporting with local engagement activities and events that help our Saudi team feel connected to the wider group and connected with each other Who you are: A KSA national who can engage confidently with both government contacts and internal leadership. Genuinely knowledgeable about Saudi labour law, visa/immigration processes and the Nitaqat/Saudization program, and committed to keeping that knowledge current as regulations evolve. A proactive, forward-looking thinker who flags risk early rather than after the fact. A strong communicator who can advise and influence senior stakeholders as comfortably as external government contacts, brokers and candidates. Meticulous and reliable with time-sensitive paperwork — visa deadlines, renewals and insurance enrolments don't get missed on your watch. A skilled recruiter who genuinely enjoys finding and engaging strong local talent. Highly organized, able to manage compliance and visa deadlines alongside multiple hiring pipelines at the same time. Trustworthy with confidential and compliance-sensitive information. What you bring: KSA National (required). Proven experience in a Saudization, government relations/PRO, visa & immigration, or senior HR role in Saudi Arabia. Hands-on experience managing expatriate visa and iqama processes — work visas, dependent/family visas, renewals, exit/re-entry and cancellations — directly or in close oversight of a provider that does. Experience coordinating with an insurance broker on employee and dependent health insurance additions, amendments and removals. Strong working knowledge of the Nitaqat/Saudization program, MHRSD regulations, and the Qiwa/Muqeem/GOSI platforms. Experience sourcing and recruiting Saudi national candidates. Experience with designing and leading Saudi National Graduate programmes Excellent stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable engaging senior leadership. Strong organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Exceptional professional written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. Ability to maintain confidentiality and interface with individuals at all levels, both inside and outside the organization. Knowledge of ATS systems and Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Our KSA Benefits include: 22 days holiday Comprehensive medical insurance plan for employee and spouse and children Flexible office times and working from home twice per week Remote working from a place of your choice for 2 weeks a year Horizontal Digital is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified Saudi nationals, including those with disabilities who possess the required skills and appropriate accommodations. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

ca7c40fb6ba53079.description: About FarmaMondo Group FarmaMondo is a Swiss pharmaceutical Group with a global presence, focused on providing access to specialty medicines for patients in developed and emerging markets. The Group partners with innovative pharmaceutical and rare disease biotech companies, operating across 13 global locations and covering over 35 markets directly. FarmaMondo is dedicated to ensuring patients receive necessary treatments regardless of their location. The Role: Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) FarmaMondo is seeking a Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) for Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh. This full-time position reports to the Managing Director & General Manager MENA, with a dotted line to the Market Access Manager KSA. The MSL will be responsible for driving and implementing medical affairs and scientific engagement activities across the Kingdom, with a primary focus on the rare disease therapeutic area. The role requires regular travel within Saudi Arabia to engage with healthcare professionals, hospital networks, scientific societies, and patient organizations. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain professional scientific relationships with the local rare disease healthcare community, including HCPs, KOLs, leading experts, key hospital accounts, scientific societies, and patient organizations. Deliver evidence-based, balanced, and compliant scientific information, and discuss novel therapeutic solutions with key stakeholders. Lead scientific discussions to support the inclusion of rare disease treatments in hospital formularies and/or the definition of treatment algorithms. Organize and lead Advisory Boards, Expert Meetings, and Medical Information sessions. Support the access pathway for newly initiated patients, collaborating with Market Access and supply teams to ensure a smooth process from treatment initiation to medication availability. Ensure timely and compliant responses to internal and external medical information requests. Provide appropriate medical support to Commercial and Market Access teams, adhering to local standards, regulations (including SFDA requirements), and internal policies. Implement medical field activities in line with FarmaMondo's strategic objectives in Saudi Arabia. Plan and execute strategic and tactical field activities that support the country's medical affairs plan, based on insights collected from KOLs and other stakeholders. Support the development of country business cases and provide medical and scientific input to build the team's business development capabilities. Partner with Market Access, Commercial, and Regulatory teams to ensure patient-focused activities. Qualifications and Experience Pharmacist (BPharm/PharmD) or Medical Doctor (MD). An advanced degree in life sciences (MSc/PhD) is also considered. Minimum of 3 years' experience as a Medical Scientific Liaison, Medical Advisor, or in a similar field-based Medical Affairs role. Solid, hands-on experience in rare diseases, neurology, or haematology is essential. Knowledge of Saudi pharmaceutical regulations (SFDA, etc.) and of pricing, access, and funding pathways (MOH, NUPCO, tenders, private funding, or other settings). Experience contributing to business cases based on patient funnel, patient journey, and insights from local or regional KOLs. Track record of engagement across all phases of the product life cycle, from pre-launch and launch to maturity, extension, or withdrawal. Experience engaging with scientific societies and patient organizations. Required Skills Strong relationship-building, listening, and follow-through abilities. Solutions-oriented, with the ability to work effectively in a complex, fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to thrive in collaborative, cross-functional teams. Focus on solving challenges to achieve optimal results for all stakeholders. Entrepreneurial mindset, capable of identifying market opportunities, taking initiative, and ensuring task completion. Proven ability to deliver impactful presentations. Strong organizational and planning skills. Strong attention to detail, with a "zero defects" mentality. Good IT skills and comfort using digital tools.

ca8561120573abab.description: The Finance & RCM Specialist is responsible for overseeing financial, billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle activities. The role ensures accurate and timely invoice and claim validation, effective financial controls, budget adherence, and strong coordination with the healthcare operator, insurers, and internal Finance teams. Key Responsibilities Financial Management Review and validate operator invoices and quotations for accuracy, completeness, and contractual compliance. Support annual budgeting, forecasting, expenditure monitoring, and cost control. Prepare monthly financial analysis, budget-versus-actual reports, and variance analysis. Identify financial risks, discrepancies, and opportunities for cost optimization. Insurance & Revenue Cycle Management Oversee monthly insurance claim submissions and ensure accuracy and compliance with insurer requirements. Monitor claim rejections, denials, outstanding claims, and collection timelines. Coordinate with the operator and insurers to resolve claim discrepancies and improve collections. Lead regular claim reconciliation and follow-up activities. Identify opportunities to reduce revenue leakage and improve RCM performance. Reporting & Compliance Prepare financial and insurance performance reports and monitor key KPIs. Provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with applicable policies, contracts, and regulations. Maintain accurate documentation and transparency across financial and claims processes. Stakeholder Management Act as the key contact for financial and insurance matters with the healthcare operator and insurers. Collaborate with the Head of Health, Operations Manager, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders to achieve financial and operational objectives. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration , or a related field; Finance/Accounting preferred. Master’s degree in Finance or a related field is an advantage. Professional certification such as CPA, CMA, or ACCA is an advantage. Experience Minimum 6 years of relevant experience , including at least 3 years in a lead or senior role . Experience in healthcare finance, insurance, billing, or revenue cycle management . Strong experience in budgeting, financial analysis, reporting, claims validation, and reconciliation. Key Competencies Strong financial and analytical skills. Good knowledge of healthcare insurance and RCM processes. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work effectively with healthcare operators, insurers, and internal teams.

ca5aa841e7b731c6.description: Job Purpose The Planning Engineer is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks, and related static equipment. The role ensures timely execution of production activities, resource allocation, and coordination between engineering, procurement, and fabrication teams to meet project deadlines and customer requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Scheduling & Planning Prepare detailed project schedules (Level 1–4) covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, welding, NDT, painting, and dispatch. Develop work breakdown structures (WBS) for each project. Track project milestones and ensure alignment with contractual delivery dates. Monitor project progress daily/weekly and update project schedules accordingly. 2. Coordination & Communication Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, QC, and Supply Chain teams for smooth workflow. Conduct weekly progress review meetings with internal teams and provide recovery plans when needed. Communicate schedule delays, risks, and impacts to management and propose corrective actions. 3. Documentation & Reporting Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports. Maintain project planning documents including fabrication status reports, manpower loading, and material delivery status. Update dashboards and KPIs for management review. 4. Resource Management Plan manpower, machines, and material requirements for each phase of fabrication. Ensure optimum utilization of workshop resources. Forecast potential bottlenecks and identify solutions in advance. 5. Monitoring Fabrication Progress Track fabrication stages such as cutting, rolling, welding, machining, assembly, hydro testing, NDT, and painting. Ensure adherence to ASME, API, and client specifications. Follow up with QC for inspection and documentation schedules. 6. Risk Management Identify project risks related to schedule, material delays, or production challenges. Develop mitigation and contingency plans. Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of fabrication processes for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks, and static equipment. Proficiency in planning software: Primavera P6 , MS Project , and Excel. Understanding of ASME Section VIII, TEMA, API standards. Excellent communication and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field. 3–6 years of experience in project planning within pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or heavy fabrication industry. Experience working in ASME-certified fabrication workshops is preferred.

caa78659cae45912.description: As a Helix Administrator at Müller’s Solutions, you will oversee the management and optimization of our Helix environments, ensuring that the development and production systems function seamlessly. Implement and optimize workflows for code branching, merging, and release management within Helix. Monitor system performance and conduct health checks to ensure high availability and responsiveness. Collaborate with development teams on best practices for version control and code integration. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Helix, providing timely support to end-users. Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical abilities for resolving system issues. Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical staff across various departments. Understanding of Agile methodologies and development lifecycles. Familiarity with other version control systems such as Git and SVN. Strong communication skills and the ability to train others on best practices. Proactive approach to system management and continuous improvement initiatives.
